evals.prompt: Are any of our installed dependencies currently in CISA KEV? Pull anything added in the last 30 days.
evals.expected_output: KEV catalog hits table with CVE / Package / Installed version / KEV deadline / Days remaining / Action, urgent rows highlighted (<14 days), and per-match memory entries created.
expectations: Reads .vulnetix/capabilities.yaml and uses derived.primary_package_manager to focus the lockfile scan
Runs `vulnetix vdb kev list --since <30-days-ago> --catalog all -o /dev/stdout` piped through _lib/jq/kev.jq (avoids the `-o json` literal-file trap)
Cross-references each KEV entry against lockfiles (package-lock.json/pnpm-lock.yaml/poetry.lock/uv.lock etc.) and prefers `.vulnetix/scans/*.cdx.json` SBOM when present
Renders a markdown table with columns: CVE | Package | Installed | KEV deadline | Days remaining | Action
Highlights rows where dueDate is < 14 days as URGENT
For each in-repo match, ensures a memory entry exists with a kev_deadline field and appends event: kev-watch to history

evals.prompt: Show me KEV additions since 2026-04-01 across both CISA and EU catalogs.
evals.expected_output: Filtered KEV report honoring --since and --catalog all, including non-CISA entries with null dueDate handled correctly.
expectations: Honors `--since 2026-04-01` and `--catalog all` (or `--catalog eu` when scoped) on `vulnetix vdb kev list`
Handles multi-source items per the edge-case note: dueDate populated only for CISA entries; non-CISA sources have dueDate: null
Handles requiredAction being null for non-CISA sources without crashing the action column
Treats knownRansomwareCampaignUse as a string comparison (`"Known"` / `"Unknown"`), not boolean truthiness
Marks Days remaining as N/A (not 0 or negative) for entries without a dueDate
Cross-references lockfiles or SBOM and lists in-repo matches first

evals.prompt: Pre-audit check — surface any KEV item in our repo past its deadline so I can escalate.
evals.expected_output: Past-deadline KEV items surfaced first, escalation path to incident-respond, plus follow-up suggestions per in-repo match.
expectations: Surfaces past-deadline in-repo KEV items at the top of the report with negative Days remaining
Suggests `/vulnetix:incident-respond <id>` for past-deadline items as the escalation path
Suggests `/vulnetix:fix <id>` and `/vulnetix:detection-rules <id>` (when detection stack present) for in-window in-repo items
Notes that the Vulnetix KEV catalog (`--catalog vulnetix`, V2 endpoint) is broader than CISA KEV — includes weaponised CVEs not yet in CISA
Writes/updates memory entries with kev_deadline and event: kev-watch for every in-repo match
Does not run `vulnetix scan` itself — reuses existing `.vulnetix/scans/*.cdx.json` SBOM if present, else falls back to lockfile grep
